parsed.rationale: The two participating records are `MP3Streamer+Playback` (the production extension in `Shared/Playback/Sources/MP3Streamer/MP3Streamer.swift`) and `MockAudioPlayerForController` (located in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/AudioPlayerControllerTests.swift`). The second record is explicitly a mock/test double living inside the test target, as evidenced by both its name prefix 'Mock' and its file path under `Tests/PlaybackTests/`. A Jaccard similarity of 0.75 between a real playback conformance and its test mock is expected and intentional — the mock must mirror the production interface closely to be a valid stand-in. Collapsing or extracting shared shape here would undermine test isolation.
